About the Researched Persuasive Writing & Speaking event

Researched Persuasive Writing & Speaking is a Leadership event in the HOSA secondary division. Format: speech & presentation · online submission.

Ten in-depth lessons for the HOSA Researched Persuasive Writing & Speaking solo event (secondary and postsecondary), built around the 2026–27 topic “Should Pharmaceutical Companies Advertise?”: how direct-to-consumer drug advertising works and is regulated by the FDA, weighing arguments and choosing a stance, researching and evaluating evidence, writing a thesis and persuasive structure, drafting and formatting the two-page paper with APA references (90 points), turning it into a five-minute speech (80 points), persuasive delivery and rehearsal. Includes ad-type sorting, fallacy spotting, mechanics drills and practice scenarios.
